label: pompe
prompt: Create ONE original native game prop for the Yautja homeworld fan game La Longue Chasse; an original lore-compatible design, not a certified canonical object. Native square PNG with TRUE transparent alpha, one single connected whole object, no atlas. Cohesive material/camera family: charcoal porous basalt and gunmetal, worn antique bronze chamfered ribs, angular shallow alien geometric marks, small contained amber indicators, realistic prerendered 2.5D detail and midtone edge contrast, warm neutral light from upper left. Three-quarter isometric view looking down25-30degrees, front and right visible. The object is SMALL and CENTERED like a miniature seen from farther away, only central50-55percent of the canvas width/height; enormous empty alpha0 margin around every side. Entire object and all base/contact parts visible. Preserve the exact native canvas the tool emits. Every pixel outside the physical object must have exact alpha0, including canvas edges; no faint isolated speckles, no outside glow, no steam/fog, no ground or shadow patch, no scenery, no background or checkerboard, no humans/animals, no text/labels/numbers/logos, no extra separate pieces, no crop/mirror, no repeated views. Candidate static drawing only; no mechanics or admission implied. SUBJECT: an independent ALIEN INDUSTRIAL PUMP for a city utility line, not a cistern, fountain or planter. A compact horizontal armored centrifugal impeller housing with a clearly visible circular bronze-ribbed face, an attached short heavy motor housing, one upward-facing flanged inlet and one side-facing flanged outlet linked to the pump body, all seated on a rugged low four-foot basalt and bronze skid. Broad shoulders and robust pipe junctions, tiny amber inspection slit. Water-routing function readable from the impeller and the TWO pipe connections. No storage tank, no plants, no domestic hand spigot, no human gasoline engine or familiar brand. This is a new whole homeworld sprite; do not repeat or extract the old six-frame Pit pump atlas.

visualAssessment.notes: One complete independent impeller/motor pump with two connected pipe flanges and an intact base. Its new Homeworld material/camera is distinct from the existing Pit atlas. Preview halo and low alpha stay uncleaned and need contextual review.

diagnosticImageAnchor.rule: Bottom-center alpha>8 enclosure. A wall-mounted object still needs an attachment pivot; this is not physical ground-contact proof.

limits: All original canvas and pixels retained; no crop,resize,mirror,cleanup or compression.
Alpha thresholds2/8 are diagnostics and never replace the strict alpha>0 measurement.
Low alpha counts include antialiasing; border speckle and clipping need individual visual interpretation.
No in-game scale,collision,usage envelope,animation or artistic admission is established.
